name: Morgan Production Traffic
description: Post-evolution production traffic for Morgan persona (senior employee, former HR compliance specialist). Tests the prediction gap: topics beyond Golden Q&A that real users ask about. Designed to run after V1 evolution to expose what bootstrap can't teach.
